notes: Every run is fresh, made on 2026-10-18 with the same tiles, prompts and settings, one pass per model.

One request per tile: all 11 models in one run per tile size, one search at a time in a shuffled order, 16 tile requests in flight. Whole-scene methods (Jev 1.14 Choice and batched): one scene at a time, the same condition. Several scenes in flight slowed each other down (Jev: about 3.2 s instead of 1.5 s).

Time counts only successful requests (results.success_times): speed when the model works, not how reliable its provider is. Perplexity (Decider Flash V1.2) and Cloudflare (Clef, Clef Flash) rejected some requests with HTTP 429.

Searches that hit a provider error were run again in full (resume --redo-failed), as were searches slower than 3x their model's median time (resume --redo-slow 3: 3 at 128 px, 8 at 192 px, 16 at 384 px; none changed found or missed). At 128 px, 37 searches were first stopped by the 150,000-request safety cap and then finished in full.
Decider V1.1 27B was retired on OpenRouter by 2026-10-18 and is not included. Mercury Decide, left out on 2026-10-16 because the provider rate-limited every request, now works and is included.

Decider Flash V1.2 can also take a whole scene in one request, but Perplexity rate-limited those requests heavily (15 of 66 scenes failed at first, even one at a time), so the owner judged that test unfair and it is not shown.
